instruction: Change the font of the first paragraph to Arial.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully selected the first two paragraphs, opened the paragraph formatting dialog, changed line spacing from Single to Double, and applied the change in 10 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select text paragraphs, open paragraph formatting dialog, change line spacing settings, save document
metadata.task_rationale: Tests font change capability on the same document. The model demonstrated it can select and modify paragraph properties; changing font is a related formatting operation at similar difficulty.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font of the first paragraph from Times New Roman to Arial. Getter reads the docx file and extracts font names from the first non-empty paragraph's runs, with fallback to paragraph style font for inherited fonts. Metric checks that ALL runs use Arial (not just any). [Fixed: getter handles font style inheritance; metric uses all-match instead of any-match logic]
fix_history: Fix 1: Getter now returns a list of fonts per run (not a set) and resolves font inheritance from paragraph style when run.font.name is None
Fix 2: Metric changed from any-match to all-match logic - all runs must use expected font for score 1.0

scoring_breakdown.font_change: 1.0 - First paragraph font changed to Arial

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts fonts from each run of the first non-empty paragraph, with fallback to paragraph style font when run.font.name is None. This handles the common font inheritance case.
Metric correctly uses ALL-match logic: iterates through every font in the list and returns 0.0 if any font does not match Arial (case-insensitive). A partially changed paragraph will correctly fail.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives {'expected_font': 'Arial'} directly from get_rule and accesses it via expected.get('expected_font').
Postconfig correctly activates the window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads the docx, ensuring fresh state.
Coverage is complete: the single instruction requirement (change first paragraph font to Arial) is fully verified.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If font is inherited from document default theme (not paragraph style), both run.font.name and style.font.name could be None, causing the getter to append None and the metric to return 0.0 (false negative). Consider also checking document-level default font as a deeper fallback, though this is an unlikely edge case when the agent explicitly sets the font.
